## The problem

What are you trying to do that's hard or impossible today?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see. Be concrete if you can.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches, workarounds you're using now, or how other tools handle this.

## Which area does this touch?

- [ ] A processing mode (passthrough / analytical / narrative / agentic / coder)
- [ ] Knowledge packs / RAG / memory
- [ ] Voice / avatars
- [ ] Media / images / games
- [ ] API compatibility (Ollama / OpenAI)
- [ ] Deployment / Docker / config
- [ ] Web UI
- [ ] Other:

## Anything else

Mockups, links, prior art.
